learning_outcomes.text: The student knows the concept of technology.
Students will be able to perceive the place of technology in social transformations.
Students gain the ability to design system solutions using the existing opportunities of each period.
Students follow technological developments and renew themselves.
They gain effective communication and presentation skills through the presentations they prepare.
